onlineIdentity.implemented: Bundled NCM preserves actual endpoint quality metadata internally; revisions bind address, actual quality and exact completed cache path. When AutoMix and provider caching are enabled, fresh authorized resolutions may prepare one complete cache file with a 10-second deadline and a 256-MiB disk limit. Playback and analysis then use the same local bytes; native transport retains a source lease. Partial, cancelled, expired or mismatched downloads are discarded. Before publication, streaming metadata inspection under the same deadline/cancellation requires recognized audio headers and valid codec/sample-rate/channel geometry, rejecting HTTP 200 error pages. This is not full-file decoder validation.
onlineIdentity.directUncachedStreams: Bundled NCM can materialise fresh sources before playback. Existing live direct streams, failed preparation, disabled caching and other providers retain conservative fallback.
